company.name: A-Plus Management & Consultation
company.description:
-Plus Management & Consultation is an independent property management, advisory & consulting, and commercial real estate investment management firm that is actively engaged in the development and operation of mixed-use, retail, entertainment and hospitality projects in Egypt. Since its inception in 2014, it developed and operated over 25 projects in Cairo, Giza, Mansoura, Domiat, Aswan, Minya, Mahalla, Tanta and Hurghada. Fulfilling business owners and investors needs for professional and trustworthy resources in guiding them in achieving the best results in serving the markets needs and in taking advantage of the rapidly changing business climate.

A-Plus specializes in identifying opportunities for commercial, retail and shopping malls that embrace the benefits of mixed use developments. In recent years we have pioneered large and medium sized projects across Egypt.
